europe_now.title: Iceland votes against restarting EU accession talks
europe_now.summary: Icelandic voters have rejected a referendum to resume European Union accession negotiations, marking a decisive shift away from potential EU membership. The outcome reflects public sentiment favoring independence over deeper integration with European institutions.

top_stories.title: NATO's Arctic expansion alarms Moscow
top_stories.summary: NATO's increasing military presence in the Arctic region has been labeled a direct threat by Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov. The warning underscores growing geopolitical friction between Western alliances and Russia over northern polar territories.

top_stories.title: Far-right and far-left dominate French political landscape
top_stories.summary: Recent opinion polls in France show the far-right and far-left parties leading over centrist and traditional mainstream parties ahead of upcoming elections. This polarization signals a potential realignment of the French electorate toward more extreme ideological positions.

top_stories.title: Ferry disaster off northern Cyprus leaves dozens dead and missing
top_stories.summary: A ferry carrying over 260 passengers capsized off the coast of northern Cyprus, resulting in multiple fatalities and many individuals reported missing. Emergency rescue operations are ongoing as authorities assess the full scale of the tragedy.
